# Write Urdu

> Write Urdu helps people type Urdu with English letters, type Urdu directly, format documents and create shareable Urdu designs. Core writing tools are free and require no account or installation.

Canonical site: https://write-urdu.com/

Important facts:

- The homepage is the main English to Urdu typing and Urdu typing online surface: type Urdu words using English letters, press Space, and get Urdu script.
- English-letter Urdu typing changes how the Urdu words are written; it does not translate an English sentence into Urdu. Writers should review ambiguous names, spellings and important text before sharing it.
- The Urdu Keyboard supports direct Urdu-character input when exact spelling or punctuation matters.
- The Rich Text Editor is intended for formatted Urdu documents, headings, lists, fonts, alignment and export.
- The homepage includes optional AI writing help for adults aged 18 and over. After writing or pasting Urdu, users can fix mistakes, improve clarity, simplify wording, change tone, shorten, expand or summarize selected text or the current paragraph. Every suggestion is shown for review before it replaces the original.
- Urdu Card Studio is the primary image-creation surface for putting Urdu text, poetry, quotes and announcements on a background or photo and exporting the finished design.
- Stylish Urdu Text Generator is the primary copy/paste surface for decorated Urdu names and short phrases; exact Nastaliq/Naskh image appearance belongs to Urdu Name Art.
- Urdu Name Art Maker is the focused image-rendering surface for Urdu name art, name images and DP/profile designs, with 24 original templates across 12 packs, six output presets and transparent PNG export.
- Local drafts and several creation workflows use browser storage or browser-side processing. English-letter Urdu suggestions may use the typing provider described in the privacy policy.
- Write Urdu does not require an account for the core editors.
- Product guides are maintained against the current public interface. Corrections can be reported through the public feedback channel, while questions that need a reply have a dedicated contact route.
- The public changelog records shipped user-facing features and improvements in customer language, with direct instructions for trying them; engineering work and unreleased ideas are excluded.
- Online since July 2016. Recent usage is measured in aggregate and lifetime scale is a labelled estimate, not a counter; see the ten-year page below.
- Not supported: translating the meaning of an English sentence into Urdu, opening complete InPage .inp files (only pasted text converts), and converting Urdu script back into Roman Urdu.
- Last reviewed: 2026-10-12.

## Start writing

- [English to Urdu typing / Urdu typing online](https://write-urdu.com/): Type Urdu words using English letters, press Space to get Urdu script, review suggestions, copy text and continue into other writing tools.
- [AI writing help inside the Urdu editor](https://write-urdu.com/#ai-writing-assistant): Select Urdu text or place the cursor in a paragraph, choose an improvement, review the suggestion, then replace, insert or copy it. The original stays unchanged until the user chooses an action.
- [Urdu Rich Text Editor](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-editor): Format Urdu with headings, fonts, colours, lists and alignment, then export a document.
- [Online Urdu Keyboard](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-keyboard): Type Urdu characters directly with an on-screen or physical keyboard, with a CRULP-style phonetic key and Shift reference.
- [Urdu Voice Typing](https://write-urdu.com/tools/urdu-voice-typing): Press Start, speak Urdu, edit the text, then copy it or continue writing. Availability depends on the browser or device.

## Convert and fix Urdu text

- [InPage to Unicode and Unicode to InPage converter](https://write-urdu.com/tools/inpage-unicode-converter): Converts pasted Urdu text between older InPage and Unicode in both directions. Unsupported characters are kept and listed for review. It does not open complete .inp files or keep page layout.
- [Urdu Text Cleaner](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-text-cleaner): Fixes broken spacing, character and text-direction problems in Urdu copied from PDFs, Word or websites.
- [Urdu image to text](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-ocr): Extracts editable Urdu text from a screenshot, photo or scan; clear printed text works best.

## Learn Urdu writing

- [Roman Urdu to Urdu converter](https://write-urdu.com/roman-urdu-transliteration): Converts Roman Urdu written with English letters into editable Urdu script, with copy and continue-editing actions plus spelling guidance.
- [Urdu typing practice and speed test](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-typing-practice): Guided Urdu keyboard lessons with WPM, accuracy, timed tests, streaks and personal bests.
- [Urdu alphabet guide](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-alphabet): Common standalone Urdu characters, names, right-to-left direction and joining behavior.
- [Complete Write Urdu documentation](https://write-urdu.com/write-urdu-documentation): English-letter Urdu typing, direct input, formatting, drafts, exports and related creation tools.
- [Write Urdu FAQ](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-faq): Product, privacy, export, typing and Urdu-script questions.
- [Urdu fonts: Nastaliq vs Naskh](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-fonts-nastaliq-vs-naskh): Practical comparison of Urdu font styles for documents, interfaces and designs.
- [How to write Urdu on a photo](https://write-urdu.com/how-to-write-urdu-on-photo): Practical steps for adding Urdu text, poetry or quotes to a local photo, choosing readable Urdu fonts and exporting the image in Card Studio.
- [English to Urdu typing tutorial](https://write-urdu.com/english-urdu-typing-tutorial): Step-by-step typing, suggestion and formatting guidance.
- [Urdu and Arabic phrases to copy](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-phrases-copy-paste): Urdu and Arabic script spellings of common phrases such as Assalamualaikum, Alhamdulillah, Mashallah and Bismillah, with Roman spelling variants and one-click copy.
- [How to share Urdu writing online](https://write-urdu.com/how-to-share-urdu-writing-online): Publish an Urdu card as a short link, see what becomes public and remove it later.

## Create and export

- [Urdu Card Studio](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-card-studio): Write Urdu text or poetry on a photo, create quote/post/announcement images with Urdu fonts and templates, and export the finished PNG.
- [Urdu Card Gallery](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-card-gallery): Type your own Urdu text once and compare it live across many card designs, then continue the one you like in Card Studio.
- [Ready-Made Urdu Cards](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-cards): Browse ready-made Urdu cards for dua, Eid, wedding, congratulations and more, then edit one in Card Studio or share its link.
- [Stylish Urdu Text Generator](https://write-urdu.com/stylish-urdu-text-generator): Generate curated copyable Urdu name/text styles, filter by category and intensity, and hand wording into image-based Name Art when exact typography matters.
- [Urdu Name Art Maker](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-name-art-maker): Render your own Urdu name as a profile/DP image or transparent name layer using Urdu-safe fonts, 24 original templates, local backgrounds and browser-side PNG export.
- [Urdu Writing Templates](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-writing-templates): Twelve editable Urdu templates for leave applications, job letters, complaints, notices, payment reminders and invitations.
- [Urdu Wedding Invitation Maker](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-wedding-invitation-maker): Build Nikah, Mehndi, Baraat and Walima invitations in Urdu, English or both and download images.
- [Urdu Template Library](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-templates): Browse starter designs and open a selected template in Card Studio.
- [Urdu and English Invoice Generator](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-invoice-generator): Create Urdu, English or bilingual invoices with automatic totals and local export.
- [Urdu Bill Generator](https://write-urdu.com/urdu-bill-generator): Create a quick Urdu, English or bilingual shop bill or receipt, track paid and balance, then print or download as PDF.
- [Static QR Code Generator](https://write-urdu.com/qr-code-generator): Create static QR codes for Urdu text, links, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp and contacts.
